body:
Backport of cms-sw/cmsdist#10893 to `IB/CMSSW_15_0_X/master`.

Bump `PhysicsTools-NanoAOD` from `V01-07-00` to `V01-07-01`, providing the Run 2024 FastSim refinement payload required by the merged cms-sw/cmssw#51946 (data: cms-data/PhysicsTools-NanoAOD#21). 

Please include this in the requested CMSSW_15_0_22 production build.
title: [15_0_X] Update PhysicsTools-NanoAOD data to V01-07-01
